title: What the overview adds under The plan

checks.text: Since you last looked, in one line: "3 new cards · 2 answered by the agent · B0 done · 9 commits" (Linear Pulse).
Health: tests green, anything uncommitted or unpushed, dev servers running (Switchboard knows).
What's owed: what your answers committed the agent to, until a commit closes each one.

why: These are the three questions the plan's steps can't answer: what changed, is anything broken or unsaved, and what's been promised. The phase strip and "the project so far" from the first version are what the sidebar's plan now is.

options.label: All three: since you last looked, health, what's owed
options.then: Add the three under The plan in the sidebar.

options.label: Since you last looked only, to start

summary: The plan in the sidebar already shows where the project is: each step done, now or next, with its open cards. The overview adds what the plan can't show, under The plan, not as a page of its own (decided, v-sidebar).
